question: Which surah addresses the divine help and the final victory of Islam?

arabic_text: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا
english_translation: and you see that the people enter Allah's religion in crowds
question: What does the word أَفْوَاجًا mean in Surah Al-Nasr?

options.A: The Day of Judgment and accountability
options.B: The duties of worship and prayer
options.C: The conquest of Makkah and people embracing Islam
options.D: The migration from Makkah to Madinah

english_translation: When comes the Help of Allah and the conquest of Makkah
question: What specific conquest is mentioned in Surah Al-Nasr?

arabic_text: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًا
english_translation: then glorify the praises of your Lord and ask for His forgiveness. Verily, He is the One Who accepts repentance and forgives
question: What does Surah Al-Nasr teach about the response to Allah's blessings and victory?

options.A: To celebrate and rejoice with the people
options.B: To glorify Allah and seek His forgiveness
options.C: To prepare for further battles and expansion
options.D: To establish laws and governance immediately
